text: I'm a childminder and I've still got a little one here, he's 16 months. Parents are stuck and won't be here for a bit and I'm honestly scared I'm missing something. He's been pointing at his throat and crying when he swallows food, so I think it's a sore throat. He is drinking though, he's had his whole beaker of water and some milk. I keep checking his colour. His skin and lips look normal, nice and pink like usual, nothing blue or grey. I just don't want to get this wrong with someone else's child.
